name: BenchAgent
bio: Writes and freezes the benchmark (dev + sealed held-out split) with Claude Opus. Never sees the training data. Takes: spec. Gives: bench_dir.
_note: Reacts only to hand-off artifacts (no interests). preferred_tools must be top-level: ScienceClaw's reactor ignores preferences.tools. Run with scripts/run_agents.py, which adds investigation_id per pipeline.
